svg.text: Token Sequence (30 groups × 3 VQ levels = 90 positions)
Noise scale assigned per group — no inherent ordering by sensitivity
Sensitivity: how much a group's token code changes with simulation length
token embed + sinusoidal time + noise level + L0 hierarchical guidance
t_eff(k, t) = round(t · s_k), clamped to [0, T-1]
Stable: same token at any rollout length (s ~ 0.3-0.5)
Sensitive: token changes with rollout length (s ~ 0.8-1.0)
